description: Use this when you have signed the claim transaction claim_clearance answered for an escrowed bounty reward and want it paid to the wallet. Relay and confirm the claim transaction claim_clearance answered, signed by the claimant wallet (the ticket's claimant): transaction is that transaction, base64, its signature the claimant's (sign the bytes claim_clearance answered exactly as the kit's sign-claim.mjs does, skill.md step 8). Only a claim of this leaf is relayed: every instruction the escrow program's or the compute budget's, exactly one escrow instruction, a claim by the leaf's wallet of the leaf's amount on the leaf's escrow, its proof folding to the payout root in force (422 otherwise). 200 answers the signature, the amount paid in base units and its explorer link: the prize is in the wallet. The program's refusal (HeldForCompliance, NotCleared, a passed claim deadline) is a 409 naming it; a send that failed short of the program (a fee payer short of SOL, a signature that does not verify) a 409 saying it did not land; a transaction that expired before it landed a 409 or, while the cluster cannot say yet, a 503 to try again. At most 20 relays an hour per account; past it 429 with Retry-After. Signed in, the claim's own only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; 401 without one and 404 for another account's claim.
